title: docs/log.md merges with merge=union; lore init writes the attribute and lore-cli adopts it (DEC-180 (4))
description: DEC-180 (4), accepted 2026-10-13 (opum-doc). docs/log.md is append-only and regenerated from git history by `lore sync` (src/core/log.ts; LOG_FILE in src/commands/sync.ts). Two branches that each append conflict at merge, though either side plus a re-run of sync is correct. No repository sets a merge attribute today (git check-attr: unspecified in lore-cli). Deliverables: (a) `lore init` writes `docs/log.md merge=union` into the root .gitattributes for new repositories, creating the file if absent and preserving existing lines (init writes .lore/.gitignore today via src/core/scaffold.ts; no .gitattributes writer exists); (b) confirm `lore sync` produces a deduped, ordered log.md after a union merge (generateLog already emits each commit once, sorted) and add the step if it does not; (c) add the one-line `docs/log.md merge=union` to the lore-cli repository root .gitattributes. Prove both ways with predicted mutation arms.

acceptanceCriteria.text: `lore init` on a fresh repository writes `docs/log.md merge=union` into the root .gitattributes (creating the file when absent); when a root .gitattributes already exists, its unrelated lines are preserved.

After a git merge that unions two branches each appending a log.md entry, `lore sync` writes a log.md with no duplicate entries in canonical order, and a second `lore sync` is byte-identical (idempotent).
The lore-cli repository root .gitattributes declares `docs/log.md merge=union`, and `git check-attr merge docs/log.md` reports `union`.

Both directions are proved with a predicted mutation arm: with the attribute removed, a merge of two branches that each append a log.md entry conflicts as predicted; with it present the merge is clean and the following sync is clean.
